description: Turn any task into production-ready code. Rules and skills work on any coding harness; specialized agents and automatic hook enforcement are a Claude Code deepening feature.

interface.longDescription:
hiway-kit is a discipline kit for coding agents. Its 17 skills turn a request into verified, production-ready code.

- Planning: plan-task writes a plan file with executable done-criteria; brainstorming handles design for large new features.
- Execution: auto-dev runs a plan through implementation and validation; test and debug run the tests, diagnose failures and fix them.
- Review: review runs lint, an adversarial code review and a security scan; multi-perspective-review and cross-engine-review reach an evidence-backed decision across perspectives or across agent engines.
- Coordination: control-loop and child-session keep multi-session work safe with clear briefs, isolated branches and verification before merge.
- Code intelligence: code-intel provides AST search, replacement previews and one-shot LSP queries; session-history searches explicitly selected local logs.
- Knowledge: web-research, skill-forge (turn a solved problem into a reusable skill), agent-creator, and harness-export (share the kit's rules with other coding agents through AGENTS.md).

Done is judged by command output, not by claims: the skills tell the agent to run the project's own tests and checks before reporting work as finished.

The kit has no telemetry or publisher service. Local helpers can read selected code and session logs and invoke installed tools. Language servers and project tools may execute workspace code, write files or access the network; use code intelligence only in trusted workspaces. Skills that search the web use the tools you already have.
